findings.issue_summary: The app creates Firebase and Google accounts and syncs a profile, but Settings has no deletion action, and the unused deletion screen only opens email or a web page.
findings.recommendation: Add a discoverable control under Settings > Account that starts account deletion in the app and deletes remote records (Firebase Auth user deletion plus synced profile and cloud data). A mail draft, an external page, or signOut() does not by itself satisfy the in-app deletion requirement. Keep the public deletion URL for the Play Console data-deletion field.

findings.evidence:
AndroidManifest.xml lines 7-8 declare android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM and android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM. The MAIN/LAUNCHER activity is .MainActivity (lines 17-33) with home-widget and dearly://invite filters; there is no alarm-clock, timer, or calendar intent handler. MorningFortuneAlarm.arm() (MorningFortuneAlarm.kt lines 92-96) calls AlarmManager.setExactAndAllowWhileIdle(RTC_WAKEUP) on API 23+ or AlarmManager.setExact otherwise, so MorningFortuneReceiver can post notification channel daily_encouragement (MorningFortuneAlarm.kt lines 122-133, description 'Fortune at 8:00 and one afternoon encouragement'). That is a local daily notification, not second-critical clock or calendar functionality; the app remains useful without it. DailyWordWidgetProvider.scheduleHourlyRefresh (DailyWordWidgetProvider.kt lines 430-440) already uses AlarmManager.setInexactRepeating for hourly widget refresh and does not need an exact alarm.

**Critic Verification**: AndroidManifest.xml lines 7-8 declare both SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM and USE_EXACT_ALARM. MorningFortuneAlarm.arm uses AlarmManager.setExactAndAllowWhileIdle on API 23+ and setExact otherwise (MorningFortuneAlarm.kt lines 92-96) so MorningFortuneReceiver can post the daily_encouragement channel (lines 122-133, description about fortune at 8:00 and an afternoon encouragement). The launcher is MainActivity with widget and dearly://invite filters, not an alarm-clock, timer, or calendar handler. applicationId is com.dearly.quoteswidget (android/app/build.gradle.kts); com.quotation.quotation is only the namespace. DailyWordWidgetProvider.scheduleHourlyRefresh already uses setInexactRepeating (DailyWordWidgetProvider.kt lines 430-440). A quotes/widget companion scheduling a local encouragement is outside the USE_EXACT_ALARM core-functionality categories. (Confidence: High)
findings.issue_summary: USE_EXACT_ALARM is not justified. The app is a quotation companion (applicationId com.dearly.quoteswidget, namespace com.quotation.quotation, launcher MainActivity) whose exact alarm only posts a local daily encouragement notification, not an alarm clock, timer, or calendar.
findings.recommendation: Remove android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM. Deliver the morning encouragement with inexact AlarmManager scheduling or WorkManager, matching the hourly widget refresh. If exact delivery is still required, keep only the already-declared SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM permission, which the user can revoke, and stop relying on the auto-granted USE_EXACT_ALARM permission.

That Firebase Auth API creates or resumes a user account and sends the account credential to Google Firebase, a first-party service provider. findings.issue_summary: Silent Background Transfer: Policy violation. Data is sent without prior disclosure.

Declare User IDs in the Play Data Safety form as collected and sent to the Firebase service provider.

Firestore is first-party. legal_copy.dart lines 109 and 238 mention the email address, but legal_screen.dart does not gate this upload.

**Critic Verification**: UserProfileSync.upsertCurrentUser writes Firebase User.email to Firestore users/{uid}.email (user_profile_sync.dart lines 17-22). That runs from DdayCloudSync.start (dday_cloud_sync.dart line 50), which AuthController starts on non-anonymous authStateChanges (auth_controller.dart lines 149-152) and from ensureAnonymous when a session already exists (lines 181-186). initialize() also calls _restoreGoogleAccount (lines 163-164), which uses GoogleSignIn.signInSilently and _linkFirebase (lines 407-412 and 292) and then upserts the profile. main.dart starts AuthController.initialize() with no consent step. The privacy-policy text does mention email (legal_copy.dart lines 108-109 and 237-238), but that is not an in-app gate. Firestore is the developer project (first-party). findings.issue_summary: Google account email is written to first-party Firestore users/{uid}.email without an in-app consent gate. UserProfileSync.upsertCurrentUser runs from DdayCloudSync.start on session restore and from silent Google restore (signInSilently then _linkFirebase) inside AuthController.initialize, before the user can open LegalScreen. The privacy policy mentions the email address, but LegalScreen is a settings document with no Accept control and does not run before the upload.
findings.recommendation: Obtain affirmative in-app consent that states the email address is stored in Firebase before upsertCurrentUser or silent Google restore runs. Declare Email in the Play Data Safety form.
